notes: Independently re-sourced 2026-08-25. Programme exists and runs — it is listed in the school's 2026/2027 audition call. Silence = NOT FOUND, not "no".
complementary_credits_required: RUCT: not applicable — Enseñanzas Artísticas register, which RUCT does not contain; confirmed zero conservatory rows in output/ruct-backbone.jsonl and output/ruct-detail.jsonl. Segundo semestre del 15 de marzo ... Trabajo Fin de Máster: del 1 al 15 de julio", i.e. teaching begins in November, so this does not match a clean September-2027 start.
notes: Independently re-sourced 2026-08-25. Candidate fit: effectively CLOSED — the acceso rule requires a music Título Superior in composition or the instrument, and the composition prueba de acceso requires three written works in score form.

ruct_code: BOE:BOE-A-2017-7086 (Orden ECD/578/2017, de 2 de junio); centre registry code 08053561
ects: 60 — "Crèdits ECTS: 60" on ESMUC's own Catalan programme page. Calendar for the current edition: "Del 2 d'octubre de 2026 al 22 de maig del 2027" (one academic year).
language_of_instruction: "Idioma de docència: Castellà" — verbatim from ESMUC's own Catalan-language programme page (NOT from the English version). ⚠ The English version of the same page renders this as "Spanish", consistent, but the Catalan original is the citable statement. Separately the programme states a competence requirement to "communicate, understand and convey abstract concepts in more than one language and especially in English" — that is a competence, not the language of delivery.
tuition_total_eur: 3,760.20 EUR tuition for the full 60 ECTS, ~3,812.20 EUR all-in. Arithmetic: ESMUC's public-prices table lists "Màster d'Ensenyaments Artístics en Investigació Musical (MEAIM) – 62,67 €" per credit; 62.67 x 60 = 3,760.20. Add the mandatory "Preinscripció al Màster – 30,00 €" and "Assegurança escolar Màster – 22,00 €" = 3,812.20. The prices page states the official master's price "already includes a 40% discount, covered by the Department of Education".
tuition_year_of_rates: NOT STATED on the prices page — ESMUC's preus públics table carries no academic-year heading. Figures are as published and accessed 2026-08-25; the same site's programme calendar for this edition is 2026-27, so these are best read as 2026-27 rates, but no year is printed.
non_eu_surcharge: NOT FOUND — ESMUC's public prices page lists 13 official masters with a single per-credit price each and no non-EU / non-resident / no comunitari row anywhere in the table, and the programme page quotes the same 62,67 € to all applicants. Per the brief, page silence is NOT FOUND rather than "no". Note this is enseñanzas artísticas superiores priced by the Departament d'Educació, not a university título priced under Catalonia's Decret de preus públics universitaris, so the Decret 96/2026 non-resident rule does not automatically transfer here.
complementary_credits_required: RUCT: not applicable — Enseñanzas Artísticas register, absent from RUCT by design (confirmed: zero conservatory rows in output/ruct-backbone.jsonl and output/ruct-detail.jsonl). Admission page (for the applicant): no complementos de formación are stated. Three access routes are published: "Llicenciatura o grau en música"; "Grau universitari amb el grau mig en música"; "Grau universitari amb coneixements musicals però sense títol oficial". The third route explicitly admits a university graduate with no official music qualification, subject to a prova d'accés of three exercises — score analysis, aural analysis and transcription. Selection is then CV 60% / motivation letter 40%. 15 places.
application_window_2027: NOT YET PUBLISHED for the 2027-28 edition (an October 2027 start) as of 2026-08-25. The calendar currently published by ESMUC for master pre-registration gives three rounds with day-and-month only, no year: preinscripció "Del 2 de febrer al 25 de març" (acceptance 15 d'abril, matrícula 22–29 d'abril); "Del 4 de maig al 24 de maig" (acceptance 9 de juny, matrícula 17–25 de juny); "Del 6 de juliol al 6 de setembre" (acceptance 6–13 de setembre, matrícula 14–18 de setembre). These correspond to the 2026-27 intake whose teaching runs 2 Oct 2026 – 22 May 2027. Dates NOT shifted forward. No separate international/non-EU deadline is published.
notes: Independently re-sourced 2026-08-25. Official status established from the BOE homologation order itself; RUCT absence is expected for this register and is not evidence against officiality. Note a naming discrepancy worth flagging, not a conflict: the BOE title is "Investigación musical", ESMUC markets it in Catalan as "Màster oficial de Recerca musical", and its own price table calls it "Màster d'Ensenyaments Artístics en Investigació Musical (MEAIM)" — three names, one title. Also note the BOE describes ESMUC as a "Centro Privado Autorizado de Enseñanzas Superiores de Música" even though it is run by a public Catalan foundation. Language of instruction was taken from the Catalan original per brief rule 7; the /ca/ URL variant 404s, the canonical Catalan page is the path without a locale prefix. Programme exists and runs — a current 2026-27 edition with published dates and 15 places. Candidate relevance: this is the most open of the five for a non-music graduate, since route 3 admits a university graduate with musical knowledge but no official music title via a theory/aural prova d'accés (no performance audition, no scores required); but delivery is in Castellà, which this candidate does not yet have.

institution: Conservatorio Superior de Música de Vigo (Galicia)
programme_name: Máster en Enseñanzas Artísticas en Creación, Interpretación e Investigación Musical
official_status: OFFICIAL — Máster en Enseñanzas Artísticas (Enseñanzas Artísticas register, not RUCT). Plan de estudios homologado by Orden EFP/668/2023, de 14 de junio (BOE-A-2023-14860, BOE núm. 149, viernes 23 de junio de 2023, sec. III, pág. 88719), title verbatim "Título de Máster en Enseñanzas Artísticas en Creación, Interpretación e Investigación Musical", centre code 36016085; evaluated favourably by ACSUG (Axencia para a Calidade do Sistema Universitario de Galicia) with a favourable report from the Consejo Superior de Enseñanzas Artísticas. The centre publishes both the BOE order and the ACSUG "Informe final de evaluación de la solicitud de verificación de título oficial" on its own máster page. The Xunta describes it as the first máster en enseñanzas artísticas in Galicia and the first application there of MECES level 3 (EQF level 7) in this sector — the same level as an official university máster. Not a título propio.
ruct_code: BOE:BOE-A-2023-14860 (Orden EFP/668/2023, de 14 de junio); centre registry code 36016085
ects: 60 over one academic year, split into two cuatrimestres. Verbatim module breakdown from the centre's own plan de estudios: "Formación básica (común a los tres itinerarios) 12 · Módulo obligatorio de cada Itinerario 24 · Módulo optativo de cada Itinerario 12 · Prácticas externas 2 · Trabajo fin de Máster 10 · TOTAL 60". Three itinerarios: Creación, Interpretación, Investigación.
modality: presencial — every single asignatura in the official plan de estudios is listed with "Modalidad: Presencial", including Prácticas externas and Trabajo fin de Máster. Full-time and part-time enrolment modes exist ("Matrícula a tiempo completo (60 ECTS)" and a part-time option) but both are presencial.
language_of_instruction: Castellano/Español + Galego, with English added in some subjects. Verbatim from the "Idiomas" field printed in each guía docente of this máster: most subjects read "Idiomas: Castellano, gallego" (or "Castelán, Galego" / "Español y gallego" / "Gallego/Castellano"); ten subjects read "Castellano, galego, inglés" or "Inglés, castellano, gallego"; one reads "Gallego" alone. No subject is taught in English only. ⚠ Galician is a co-language of instruction throughout, not an optional extra.
tuition_total_eur: ~567 EUR for the full 60-ECTS programme (1ª matrícula). Arithmetic: 60 ECTS x 7,80 EUR/ECTS (first enrolment) = 468, plus proba de acceso 64 + apertura de expediente 22 + servizos xerais 13 = 567. Only the proba de acceso figure is confirmed on the centre's own document, verbatim: "PROBA DE ACCESO ... Máster en Creación, Interpretación e Investigación ... 64 €", citing "Normativa: Decreto 89/2013 do 13 de xuño, DOG do 17-06-2013". The per-credit and administrative figures (7,80 EUR/ECTS first enrolment; 11,50 EUR/ECTS second and subsequent; 22 EUR expediente; 13 EUR servizos xerais; 1 EUR/ECTS credit recognition) come from Decreto 163/2024, do 24 de xuño, which modifies Decreto 89/2013, read via the Xunta's consolidated-law portal lex.gal — I did NOT read the DOG original, so treat the per-credit figure as one-source. Bonificacións/exencións apply to familia numerosa, disability >=33%, terrorism and gender-violence victims, and teaching civil servants.
tuition_year_of_rates: 2024-25 onward — Decreto 163/2024 states it applies from the 2024/25 academic year, with a transitional provision covering enrolments begun before entry into force. No later modifying decree found as of 2026-08-25, so these are the rates in force for 2026-27, but no decree explicitly stamped "2026-27" was located for enseñanzas artísticas superiores. NOTE the negative check: Galicia's DECRETO 72/2026, do 29 de xuño (DOG 127, 9/7/2026) fixes 2026/27 prices for the public UNIVERSITIES of the Sistema universitario de Galicia only and does not govern this título.
non_eu_surcharge: NOT FOUND — no non-EU / non-resident tariff is published for enseñanzas artísticas superiores in Galicia. Decreto 163/2024 (and Decreto 89/2013 which it modifies), the decrees that actually price this máster, contain no provision for estudantes estranxeiros non comunitarios or non residentes; the exemption list is entirely domestic-status based. ⚠ Do not carry over the university rule: DECRETO 72/2026 does let each public university set non-EU máster prices by rectoral resolution (capped at that university's 2025/26 non-EU price), but that decree governs the Sistema universitario de Galicia, not this conservatory. Silence = NOT FOUND, not "no".
complementary_credits_required: RUCT: not applicable — Enseñanzas Artísticas register, absent from RUCT by design (confirmed: zero conservatory rows in output/ruct-backbone.jsonl and output/ruct-detail.jsonl). Admission document (for the applicant): NO complementos de formación are imposed, and the degree bar is explicitly open, quoted verbatim — "Para acceder a las enseñanzas oficiales de Máster será necesario estar en posesión de un Título Superior oficial de Enseñanzas Artísticas, de un título oficial de Graduado o Graduada o su equivalente expedido por una institución del Espacio Europeo de Educación Superior... Asimismo, podrán acceder los titulados conforme a sistemas educativos ajenos al Espacio Europeo de Educación Superior sin necesidad de la homologación de sus títulos, previa comprobación por la Administración educativa competente de que aquellos acreditan un nivel de formación equivalente." ⚠ This is the single most useful finding in this batch for a non-EEES candidate: a Tunisian degree can access WITHOUT homologación, subject to an equivalence check by the education administration. Two hard language gates instead: "Será imprescindible acreditar un nivel mínimo de inglés correspondiente al Intermedio (B1) MCER o equivalente", and "Los estudiantes extranjeros cuya lengua materna no sea el español deberán acreditar documentalmente un nivel mínimo de español Intermedio (B1) MCER o equivalente". Prueba de acceso by itinerario: Creación = "Presentación y defensa de un portafolio personal (máximo de 20 minutos) con una selección escogida libremente de composiciones -sean publicadas o inéditas- y/o proyectos artístico-culturales (50%)" plus expediente 20%, currículum 15%, entrevista 15%; Investigación = portfolio of articles/papers OR audio-video recordings plus defence of a freely chosen research topic (50%) plus the same 20/15/15; Interpretación = 40-minute public audition (or a single-take unedited video) at 50%. Separately the centre publishes a formal "Transferencia y reconocimiento de créditos" regime under RD 1614/2009 art. 6.1, Decreto 163/2015 art. 10 and the Orde do 21 de novembro de 2016 (DOG 1/12/2016) — relevant to the 300-ECTS advanced-standing question, though it recognises content correlation, not surplus credits per se.
application_window_2027: NOT YET PUBLISHED for curso 2027-28 (a September 2027 start) as of 2026-08-25. Published window for CURSO 2026-27, verbatim from the centre's "Calendario de acceso ao Máster ... CURSO 2026-27": matrícula nas probas de acceso "DO 12 AO 19 DE XUÑO" (2026), matrícula extraordinaria na proba de acceso "Ata o 23 de xuño de 2026", listas provisionais de admitidos 25 de xuño de 2026 (13:00), reclamacións 25-26 de xuño, listas definitivas 26 de xuño de 2026 (16:00), "Realización de las pruebas de acceso: Do 1 ao 2 de xullo de 2026", cualificacións 3 de xullo de 2026 (13:00), reclamacións 6-7 de xullo, lista definitiva de aspirantes que superaron a proba 8 de xullo de 2026 (13:00), "Matrícula no Máster: Del 9 al 16 de xullo de 2026". A September extraordinary convocatoria also exists — its last published concrete dates are for curso 2025-26 ("Inscrición para o acceso de setembro: Do 21 ao 24 de xullo de 2025", probas 2-3 de setembro de 2025). Dates NOT shifted forward; by pattern the 2027-28 equivalent would fall June-July 2027.
notes: Independently re-sourced 2026-08-25 from the centre's own PDF documents (downloaded and text-extracted directly, not read through an aggregator). Official status established from the BOE order, which the centre itself republishes alongside the ACSUG verification report. RUCT absence is expected for this register and is not evidence against officiality. Programme exists and demonstrably runs: the centre has published, for CURSO 2026-27, a vacancy list, a full access calendar, provisional and definitive lists of admitted candidates, and named access tribunals sitting "mércores 1 de xullo de 2026" — a live, current intake. Of the five programmes in this batch this is the one with the clearest opening for a non-EEES engineering graduate: no homologación required, a free-choice portfolio in the Creación itinerary ("proyectos artístico-culturales" counts, so a producer's work is admissible in principle), the cheapest fees by an order of magnitude (~567 EUR vs 7,000 EUR at Katarina Gurska), and a formal credit-recognition regime. The blockers are language, not qualification: mandatory English B1 (easy for this candidate) and mandatory Spanish B1 for non-native speakers (this candidate is A0/A1), with Galician co-taught alongside Castilian in every subject.
